body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-10-29 (Q2FY25 concall transcript): "Of course, absolutely. And once the new capacity comes online, of course, definitely, we should be expecting an improvement in that." Metric: Quarterly revenue. Target: INR 1,000-1,100 cr/qtr in H2FY25; higher once 75k t is online. Deadline: 2025-03-31 then FY26. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: Q3FY25 1,135; Q4FY25 1,288; Q1FY26 1,254; Q2FY26 1,262 cr (screener), at or above the run-rate, then up after the capacity came online.
